title: Miners’ march from Parliament to Georgian Manganese headquarters, Tbilisi, 20 June
event_summary: After overnight tents near Parliament, miners and supporters marched to Georgian Manganese’s Tbilisi headquarters; Civil Georgia says they went to make their voices heard by company management.
exclusion_reason: Inspected reporting identifies the employer as the target of this march and does not establish a demand to Georgia’s own state or policy. A separate parliamentary protest later in the campaign remains recorded separately; city location and labor subject alone do not establish a state target.

date.summary: Civil Georgia reports the march on 20 June.

location.summary: Route from Parliament to Georgian Manganese office in Tbilisi.

target.summary: Article says the march sought to make miners’ voices heard by company management.

notes: No attendance estimate is available; exclusion is based on the documented private-company target, not on size.
